verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Vapi's own MCP server, which lets external AI assistants call Vapi APIs. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks for. Webhook-based custom tools and OpenAI-style function calling are adjacent tool mechanisms, and nothing in the pack shows Vapi assistants connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
